approach_rationale: Cold-start no store US (12.8 dl/dia GLOBAIS, share US menor). Velocity > attribution. Per-keyword rank tracking via Astro permite post-hoc attribution. Exceção contextual à regra '1 variável por iter'.

hypothesis.if_we_change: Subtitle de 'First Foods & Solid Starts Log' para 'Solid Starts & First 100 Foods' (mantém as duas âncoras, troca 'Log' morto por '100' — destrava a jornada 'first 100 foods' peso 3×, convenção do nicho que o 1.5.0 implementa nativamente); E keywords de 'starting solids,weaning,puree,feeding,recipes,allergen,infant,toddler,nutrition,meal plan,6 month' (1 dup de name [weaning] + 7 tokens mortos rank OUT diff 45-79) para 'meals,introducing solids,food,diary,allergy,log,finger,starting,bites,cut,6 month,stage 1,puree,list' (hub de composição 'food' + moats de feature diff 5-24). Análise palavra-por-palavra em research/keyword_candidates.md.
hypothesis.then_we_expect: Impressions diárias US ↑ ≥30% e downloads diários globais ↑ ≥25% em 30 dias (12.8 → ≥16 conservador / ≥19.2 bold)
hypothesis.because: (a) 'first 100 foods'/'100 first foods' (diff 11, rank OUT hoje) entram no subtitle peso 3× com feature real no app — esperado top-30; (b) token 'food' destrava o hub 'baby food *' (diary/log/chart/list/allergies/6 months — 6 long-tails diff 5-43 onde hoje só compomos parcial); (c) 7 tokens mortos (feeding/recipes/allergen/infant/toddler/nutrition/meal plan — todos OUT com diff 45-79) liberam 60+ chars pra 13 termos ganháveis diff 5-24; (d) 'meals' compõe 'blw meals' (pop 9, brand do #2) via name; (e) rank-protects: starting solids r19 mantém starting+solids, weaning log r5 mantém via 'log' no kw field.
